senses.gloss: (= הד־הדי, v. הַד־) each other, mutually. Targ. II Esth. I, 7 להדדי = הדא להדא (ed. Lag. לחדדי, Var. לה׳; cmp. Syr. חדדא P. Sm. 1196).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 68a:8">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>כבשינהו אה׳</he> (= <he>הדא אהדא</he>) squeeze them against each other.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:14">Ib. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>בהדי ה׳</he> with one another (in immediate contact).
Ḥull. 43ᵃ, v. הַנְדֵּז; a. fr.—כי ה׳ (= הדא כי הדא) like each other.
Snh. 4ᵇ (ḥeleb a. ḥăleb) דכי ה׳ נינהו which are written alike.
<cite ref="Eruvin 69b:9">Erub. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>כי ה׳ וכ׳</he> are in the same legal category.
<cite ref="Yevamot 14a:4">Yeb. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>כי ה׳</he> of equal rank in scholarship; a. e.
